name: RC-B10-0355/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian hybrid threats and malign interference
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It supports Moldova's independence and its path to joining the European Union. It condemns Russia for trying to destabilise Moldova before the parliamentary elections on 28 September 2025, through disinformation, secret funding of political actors and pressure over energy supplies. It asks the European Union to give Moldova more money, technical help and sanctions against those responsible.

- The European Union is asked for more money, expert help and sanctions; Moldova and its voters are affected.
- Moldova is urged to keep reforming its courts and fight corruption; its government and people are affected.
- The European Union is asked to open the first stage of membership talks with Moldova; no date is set.
